interview.question: Provide nine independently attributable original-time decisions and exceptions, not a shared approval. F01.01: identify the approved central workspace and justify separate tenant, RBAC, ownership, sovereignty and per-resource same-table retention exceptions, with complete ingestion evidence. F01.02: approve single versus regional workspaces against required geography/resilience, VM bandwidth versus diagnostic-setting egress, access and cost; location labels/counts do not establish suitable design. F01.03: specify each required dataset's retention/recovery/privacy obligations and source-qualified analytics versus total day periods, acknowledging current4383-day/12-year total, ARM inheritance, Basic30 versus old provider8 and CLI2556 differences; if longer or tamper protection is required, show supported selected-table new-data export, historical coverage, actual same-region destination/container delivery and suitable locked/version/container WORM/legal hold interval, not settings-only legal assurance. F01.04: identify required Azure/Arc OS configuration drift audits, current OS/client/architecture and November2026 compatibility, prerequisite identity/extension and exact Policy/guest assignment scope/mode, then attributable completed audit/freshness/coverage evidence; assignments are not executed audits. F01.05: demonstrate actual Windows/Linux Azure VM Update Manager adoption, eligibility, extension/source health, maintenance and business-continuity schedules, complete patch results and exceptions; assessmentMode/patchMode are not installed updates. F01.06: separately demonstrate outside-Azure Arc server enrollment/support/connectivity, extension/source health, schedules, scope and actual patch results/exceptions; AzureRM4.50.0 Arc has no patch fields, and Log Analytics/Automation is not a prerequisite. F01.07: show required Network Watcher flow/traffic analytics operation, VNet migration from NSG flow logs (no new creation; retirement2027-09-30), actual supported targets, arriving storage/analytics, freshness/coverage and owned response; regional enablement or definitions are not executed traffic analysis. F01.08: independently designate critical shared services and review actual lock scope/level, full ancestor coverage, removal authority, control-plane/data-plane limits, side effects and exceptions; no management-group or subscription-cancellation protection inferred. F01.09: demonstrate appropriate Policy deny plus role-assignment guardrails with exact definitions/versions/conditions/parameters, assignment/enforcement, scope/inheritance/exemptions and actual permitted/blocked operations; distinguish RBAC deny assignments/private preview, no generic literal effect or role presence proves effective enforcement.
